svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 305 mm of 20 x 12 flat bar. The 12 mm faces are front and back.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Grind a 45 degree chamfer, 8 mm, on the front bottom corner: the nose.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Front face: eight holes, drill 5.0 and tap M6, 15 mm deep, centred, at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 222.5 to 292.5 mm from the bottom, every 10 mm (depth settings).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 6.5 mm holes across, 8 mm from the rear face, 15 and 40 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the bottom, for the boot plates.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: front face flat on the rear of the opener cross member, two M6

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bolts from the front into two tapped holes 20 mm apart. Using the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: lowest pair gives 60 mm depth; each pair up is 10 mm shallower.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the shank hangs square to the frame; the nose points forward.
